summary: Ubuntu 8.10 (Intrepid Ibex) was released on 30 October 2008. It added RAID support, mobile computing improvements, 3G support, and a guest account with limited rights (files wiped on logout). Also: encrypted private directory, Dynamic Kernel Module Support (DKMS) for auto-rebuilding drivers, support for creating USB flash drive images. The default wallpaper depicted an ibex with curved horns.
notes: Unsupported since 2010-04-30. Kernel 2.6.27. Guest accounts improved shared-computer scenarios.
